summary: Overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive (93%+ 5-star rating). Customers highlight the extraordinarily welcoming and warm staff, the quiet and aesthetic sanctuary vibe, exceptional specialty coffee (especially the signature sea salt latte), high-end organic teas served in delicate porcelain sets, and fresh cabinet savouries.

key_themes.description: Staff are described as incredibly kind, welcoming, and sweet, consistently making patrons feel at home.
sample_quotes: The staff are so kind and sweet, and make me feel at home!
The staff were also very friendly and welcoming. I’d love to come back again.

key_themes.description: A calm, peaceful sanctuary tucked away in Eden Terrace. Features vintage wooden furniture, Spanish ceramics, and fine porcelain teaware. Perfect for quiet reading, remote laptop work, and intimate catchups.
sample_quotes: The interior is so cute and amazing, it feels like home. It makes you feel like you want to work there.
Beautifully curated spot for meeting working remote or just some me time. I like their interior and artistic display of the Spanish ceramics.
It’s peaceful and quiet, perfect for relaxing, reading, or catching up with a friend.

key_themes.description: Masterfully crafted espresso, latte art, and innovative signature recipes like the Sea Salt Iced Latte and Dirty Latte.
sample_quotes: I'm a coffee person and let me tell you, the drinks that were served to me were out of this world. It's a must try place !
The wonderful sea salt latte was surprisingly tasty.
Kudos to the team for brewing such amazing coffee.

key_themes.description: Organic Zealong NZ and Lupicia Japanese teas presented in elegant ceramic teaware and teapots.
sample_quotes: This cafe offers a variety of tea options. I tried the rose something tea, and it had a lovely strawberry-like aroma and taste.
I really like the various teas they have in stock.

key_themes.description: Freshly prepared savoury quiches, artisan sandwiches, cajun wraps, croissants, and homemade pasta/meatball specials.
sample_quotes: Lovely little cafe with a variety of drinks and light food available... as well as the sandwiches.
